subject: The damage model: eWeaponType taxonomy + armour/health

absorption_model.order: armour (+0x548) absorbs first; overflow spills into health (+0x540); both floored at 0.0
absorption_model.armour_bypass: WEAPON_FALL (0x36) and WEAPON_DROWNING (0x35) skip armour entirely (damage-response calculator @0x4AD550) - armour does not protect against falls or drowning (C45.4)

damage_source_answer.hit_by_vehicle: WEAPON_RAMMEDBYCAR (49) / WEAPON_RUNOVERBYCAR (50); magnitude from CPhysical impact (C42)
damage_source_answer.drowning: WEAPON_DROWNING (53); triggered by the underwater breath timer

event_flow.note: a source builds CEventDamage(weaponType, bodyPart); the calculator computes the response; the event enters the ped's C41 event group and the task tree reacts (flinch/fall/die)

ties.C42: CPhysical impact velocity for fall/vehicle damage
